description:
Cast Peer into the Abyss by paying {4}{B}{B}{B}, causing target opponent to draw half their library and lose half their life.
Activate Folio of Fancies's last ability by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, causing each opponent to mill cards equal to the number of cards in their hand.
During their draw step, the opponent targeted in step 1 loses the game due to drawing from an empty library.
